Name: Increasing the availability of accessible swings in playgrounds.
Title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to increasing the availability of accessible swings in playgrounds

History.Description: This Introduction was Introduced by Council
This Introduction was Referred to Comm by Council to the Committee on Parks and Recreation

Summary: This bill would require the Department of Parks and Recreation (DPR), to install and maintain swings that can be enjoyed by children between the ages of two and twelve who have certain disabilities. Specifically, DPR must install accessible swings in half of the playgrounds under their jurisdiction by December 31, 2033, and all the playgrounds under their jurisdiction by December 31, 2036. Where it is determined that such requirements are not feasible due to a lack of space, DPR must provide specific justification in writing to the Speaker and the local Council Member.
Text:
A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to increasing the availability of accessible swings in playgrounds 
 
Be it enacted by the Council as follows:
 
Section 1. Chapter 1 of title 18 of the administrative code of the city of New York is amended by adding a new section 18-172 to read as follows:
§ 18-172 Accessible swings. a. Definitions. For purposes of this section, the term “accessible swing” means a swing that is designed to meet or exceed the guidelines promulgated by the United States access board pursuant to section 12101 of title 42 of the United States code for playground equipment and offers children with disabilities, who are between the ages of 2 and 12, or any subset of such ages, the ability to experience swing play.
b. The commissioner shall ensure that by December 31, 2033, half of all playgrounds under the jurisdiction of the department are equipped with at least 2 accessible swings, and by December 31, 2036, all playgrounds under the jurisdiction of the department are equipped with at least 2 accessible swings.
c. The commissioner shall ensure that any playgrounds that newly come under the jurisdiction of the department are equipped with at least 2 accessible swings within 2 years of coming under the jurisdiction of the department.
d. The commissioner shall ensure that any newly constructed playgrounds under the jurisdiction of the department are equipped with at least 2 accessible swings.
e. The commissioner shall ensure that all accessible swings at playgrounds under the jurisdiction of the department are maintained in good working order.
f. Where the commissioner determines that the installation of an accessible swing at a particular playground is infeasible, the commissioner shall notify the speaker of the council, and the council member representing the district where such playground is located, within 10 days of such determination being made. Such notice shall be in writing, specifying the location of such playground, and stating the basis for the commissioner’s determination.
§ 2. This local law takes effect immediately
